responsibility: This OS configuration header adapts the MIPS backend to RTEMS ELF targets. It installs RTEMS-specific preprocessor builtins and assertions such as __rtems__ and __USE_INIT_FINI__, and it forces the MIPS small-data threshold to zero so generated code uses -G0 as expected by RTEMS BSPs, making it the lightweight RTEMS integration layer on top of the generic MIPS ELF configuration.
